title: Statistical Computing (TUM, Modul MA3404)
description: After successful completion of the course, students can simulate random variables in the R statistical package using complex algorithms and graphical checks for correctness. They can use R to effectively visualize real multivariate datasets, as well as develop appropriate statistical inference procedures based on the bootstrap, jackknife and permutation methods. They can perform Bayesian inference using MCMC algorithms to fit posterior distributions. Alternatively, they can solve complex frequentist inference problems using MC methods and perform statistical likelihood maximization using advanced optimization algorithms. 5 ECTS, angeboten im Sommersemester, Version 2023s, verantwortet von Ankerst, Donna.
